versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides volume-price analysis rules to help users verify the authenticity of price movements in A-shares and avoid false trading signals.

- Explains how to identify effective uptrends, false breakouts (诱多), bottom reversals, effective downtrends, and false breakdowns (诱空) using volume.
- Includes practical guidance for common real-world trading scenarios and questions.
- Rules focus on comparing volume changes with price action to determine market intent.
